structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns

law.catch_line: Enjoyment of city status until requirements of chapter fulfilled
law.text: A city which no longer qualifies for city status under Article VII, Section 1 of the Constitution of Virginia shall change to town status under the provisions of this chapter. Until the court enters an order under § 15.2-4004 for such change, a city shall enjoy all the rights and obligations of city status.
